details: Qualification: 12th Pass (10+2) from a recognized board. Male candidates must have a valid LMV Driving License (Motor Cycle or Car) on the date of PE&MT. Age Limit: 18 to 25 years (Relaxation: SC/ST 5 yrs, OBC 3 yrs). Exam Pattern: 100 Questions, 100 Marks, 90 Minutes, 0.25 negative marking (GK/Current Affairs 50, Reasoning 25, Numerical Ability 15, Computer 10). Physical (Male): Height 170 cm, Chest 81-85 cm, Race 1600m in 6 min, Long Jump 14 ft, High Jump 3'9''. Physical (Female): Height 157 cm, Race 1600m in 8 min, Long Jump 10 ft, High Jump 3 ft.

Qualification: 12th Pass (10+2) + Valid Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) Driving License + knowledge of vehicle maintenance. Age Limit: 21 to 30 years (Relaxation as per rules). Exam Pattern: 100 Marks, 90 Minutes (GA 20, Reasoning 20, Numerical Ability 10, Road Sense/Vehicle Maintenance/Traffic Rules 50). Trade Test: Driving Test (LMV & HMV forward/reverse/parking) + Traffic signs & maintenance.
